   ```

   ```
   File created successfully at: <home>\AppData\Local\Temp\s12-e3_x5od3\proj\allowed\e9-in.txt (file state is current in your context â€” no need to Read it back)

spike-open is described as the neutral control with no path rule in its prompt. Even so, the project's `.claude/hooks/guard_by_role.py` hook blocked it by role. So the path guard applies to spike-open as well as spike-guarded, and it was the hook that blocked the write, not the agent's instructions. If spike-open is meant to have no guard at all, this test doesn't give you that.
